pairs.before:
Current Drawings, Set-out and Framing Materials

Architectural plans describe the spaces, while structural and supplier details establish member sizes, supports and connections for the affected work. Check that the drawing revisions agree before setting out wall lines, opening dimensions, stair voids and service allowances. Unresolved dimensions or conflicting details need an answer from the responsible project party before installation.

Timber selection follows the specified member, treatment and exposure, rather than substituting a similar-looking piece. Agree who orders and supplies timber, proprietary connections and trusses, and how deliveries will be stored and protected on site. Keeping material schedules with the current drawings makes it easier to identify a supply omission or changed detail before it disrupts the framing sequence.
pairs.after:
Current Drawings, Set-out and Framing Materials

For a framing quote, send the current architectural, structural and supplier drawings and tell us the build stage. We check that revisions agree before setting out wall lines, openings, stair voids and service allowances. Unresolved dimensions or conflicting details need an answer from the responsible project party before the affected work starts.

Supply and materials: confirm who orders and supplies timber, proprietary connections and trusses. The member, treatment and exposure follow the project specification rather than a similar-looking substitute. Keep the material schedule with the current drawings so omissions or changed details can be resolved before installation.

Access and deliveries: describe the route for long members, lifting access and where deliveries can be stored and protected. We review those arrangements with the framing scope before the quote is agreed.

pairs.before:
Existing-home Carpentry: Define the Timber Work

Renovation carpentry starts with the rooms, retained elements and proposed changes. Existing walls may be uneven, floors may have changed and previous alterations can leave conditions that early drawings do not show. MEL ONE assesses accessible timber and junctions before defining repair, replacement or new finishing work.

A renovation package can combine doors, jambs, skirtings, architraves and agreed timber repairs or joinery interfaces. Framing alterations remain conditional on the required design, assessment and project arrangements. Identify who owns each timber task and each adjoining trade package so one carpentry allowance is not read as permission for the entire renovation.

pairs.before:
Timber Rot: Understand the Damage and the Cause

Timber rot repairs begin by locating the affected element and checking the safely accessible condition around it. Soft timber, staining, open joints, sticking openings and movement can have different causes. A cracked filler repair with soft material beneath it needs assessment of the remaining timber, not another assumed cosmetic patch.

Moisture paths, drainage, ventilation, coatings and adjoining services help explain why deterioration may return. Roofing, plumbing, waterproofing or glazing problems can need another specialist's investigation and remedy. Record which cause is confirmed, what remains uncertain and who resolves it before the repaired area is closed or finished.
pairs.after:

If you are unsure which timber is affected, or decay crosses several components, we assess the safely accessible damage and compare local repair, splicing or replacement. Tell us about softness, open joints or movement. For a clearly identified window, pergola, fascia or weatherboard fault, use the matching repair service below.

Moisture paths, drainage, ventilation, coatings and adjoining services help explain why deterioration may return. Agree removal, protection, access and specialist handovers before permanent work begins. 现行图纸、定位放线与框架材料

建筑图纸说明空间布局，结构和供应商详图则确定相关施工的构件尺寸、支承和连接。在墙线、洞口尺寸、楼梯洞口和设施预留位置放线前，须确认各图纸版本一致。未确定的尺寸或互相矛盾的细节，应由负责项目方在安装前答复。

木材选择须遵循规定的构件、处理方式和暴露条件，不能仅凭外观相似替换。约定由谁订购和供应木材、专用连接件及屋架，以及到场材料如何存放和保护。将材料清单与现行图纸一并保存，有助于在影响框架施工顺序前发现漏供材料或变更细节。
pairs.after:
现行图纸、定位放线与框架材料

申请框架施工报价时，请提供现行建筑图纸、结构图纸和供应商详图，并告诉我们工程阶段。墙线、洞口、楼梯洞口和设施预留位置放线前，我们核对图纸版本是否一致。尚未确定的尺寸或互相矛盾的细节，须由负责项目方在相关施工开始前答复。

供材与材料：确认由谁订购和供应木材、专用连接件及屋架。构件、处理方式和暴露条件须符合项目规定，不能仅凭外观相似替换。将材料清单与现行图纸一并保存，以便在安装前解决漏供或详图变更。

进场与交付：说明长构件的运输路线、吊装通道，以及到场材料的存放和保护位置。确定报价前，我们结合框架施工范围核对这些安排。

pairs.before:
木材腐烂：了解损坏与原因

木材腐烂维修先定位受影响构件，并检查周围可安全接近的状况。木材变软、污渍、接缝张开、门窗卡滞及位移可能有不同原因。若填补修补处开裂且下方木材变软，需要评估剩余木材，不能再次默认只做外观修补。

水分路径、排水、通风、涂层及相邻设施有助于解释劣化为何反复。屋面、水管、防水或玻璃安装问题可能需要其他专业方调查和解决。封闭或完成维修部位前，应记录已确认原因、尚不明确之处及负责解决者。
pairs.after:
木材腐烂：了解损坏与原因

如果您不确定哪些木材受损，或腐烂涉及多个构件，我们会评估可安全检查的损坏，比较局部维修、拼接或更换。请告诉我们是否出现木材变软、接缝张开或位移。若已明确是窗户、凉棚、檐口封板或外墙挂板的问题，可使用下方对应的专项维修入口。
